basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old software developer from Seattle with a passion for retro gaming, especially Fossil Fighters. During the day, I work on building apps, and by night, I dive into the world of classic games. I love discussing gaming strategies and sharing tips with fellow enthusiasts. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends hiking or exploring new indie games. I'm mostly online during evenings and late nights.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington. I have been programming since high school, starting with simple game mods and eventually moving into app development. My expertise is in software development and retro gaming culture, gained through years of both formal education and personal exploration.
